normalizations: temp roots replaced by $DIR (tool dir), $OUT (split output dir) and $TMP (TMPDIR); symdesk-barcode-<random> by symdesk-barcode-N; .symdesk-pdf-<random> by .symdesk-pdf-N

scripts.pdftoppm:
#!/bin/sh
PATH=/usr/bin:/bin
d=${0%/*}
US=$(printf '\037'); RS=$(printf '\036'); l=P; for a in "$@"; do l="$l$US$a"; done
printf '%s\n' "$l" >> "$d/log"
if [ -f "$d/pdftoppm.exit" ]; then
  [ -f "$d/pdftoppm.err" ] && cat "$d/pdftoppm.err" >&2
  exit "$(cat "$d/pdftoppm.exit")"
fi
prefix=$5
for f in "$d"/img/*; do
  [ -f "$f" ] || continue
  cp "$f" "$prefix-$(basename "$f")"
done
for f in "$d"/img/*; do
  [ -d "$f" ] && mkdir -p "$prefix-$(basename "$f")"
done
exit 0
scripts.qpdf:
#!/bin/sh
PATH=/usr/bin:/bin
d=${0%/*}
US=$(printf '\037'); l=Q; for a in "$@"; do l="$l$US$a"; done
printf '%s\n' "$l" >> "$d/log"
if [ "$1" = --show-npages ]; then cat "$d/npages"; exit 0; fi
if [ "$1" = --check ]; then
  if [ -f "$d/check.exit" ]; then [ -f "$d/check.err" ] && cat "$d/check.err" >&2; exit "$(cat "$d/check.exit")"; fi
  exit 0
fi
printf 'PART %s' "$4" > "$6"
exit 0
